description: Upload a local audio file or import from a supported music URL. Supported platforms: SoundCloud, YouTube, Suno, Udio, TikTok, Stable Audio, and Riffusion. Provide exactly one of file_path or url. Returns a music_id for generate_music_video or generate_effect.

file_path.description: Local audio file path. Set this or url, not both.

url.description: Supported music source URL from SoundCloud, YouTube, Suno, Udio, TikTok, Stable Audio, or Riffusion. Set this or file_path, not both.

name: upload_audio

message.description: A human-readable summary of the audio source preparation result.

music_id.description: The audio asset ID to pass into generate_music_video or generate_effect.

success.description: Whether the audio upload or import completed successfully.
